title: Queries Quality and Percentage
sourceNote: AI-authored requirements draft local-reference/leetcode/manual/1211.txt; no recovered raw statement exists in the archive (index status missing-statement).
summary: For each query_name compute quality as the average of rating divided by position, and poor_query_percentage as the percentage of rows whose rating is below 3. Both values are rounded to two decimals; repeated records count as separate observations.
outputFormat: Per query_name: quality and poor_query_percentage, both to two decimals.
edgeRules: NULL query_name handling and position values that are zero are not stated; the draft asks to verify NULL names.
